text:
```yaml
name: Claude Spellcheck

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  spellcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run Claude spellcheck
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are a spellchecker for Rust code. Review the changes in this PR and suggest corrections for any misspelled words in comments, documentation, and string literals. Output a patch file with the corrected code. If no changes are needed, output "No changes required."
          max_turns: 1
          model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620
          claude_env: |
            ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Commit spellcheck changes
        if: steps.claude.outputs.execution_file != ''
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          add: ${{ steps.claude.outputs.execution_file }}
          message: "Apply spellcheck corrections"
          author_name: Claude Bot
          author_email: claude@example.com
          cwd: .
          push: true
```
